effect.shortEffect: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.
effect.full: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

french.sv: Si le Pokémon est touché par une capacité de type Feu,\nil ne subit aucun dégât et sa Défense augmente\nbeaucoup.

english.sv: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

japanese.sv: ほのおタイプの　技を　受けると ダメージを　受けずに 防御が　ぐーんと　上がる。
